dimensions.agentReviewQuestion: Is each defined term used with its source definition and context references preserved?
Are scope, actor, modality, timing, and limiting phrases retained rather than strengthened or dropped?
Does an exception remain linked to the provision it qualifies without erasing separately operative duties?
Are definitions, scope, and exception references followed to the same pinned legal source version?
Is a duty about an external activity represented without inventing repository evidence or customer context?
Does every authored proposition and context relation cite one immutable legal source version and exact source identity?

integrityChecks: source bytes, source hashes, and legal source versions match the accepted synthetic pins
every source and context reference resolves to an accepted locator
all references in one candidate use one legal source version
duplicate rule IDs and orphan relation endpoints are rejected
fake, stale, and repealed source references are rejected
every required source locator is covered or the candidate is rejected with a coverage gap
a failed rule set submission does not replace the earlier active rule set pointer
